character: Avoriaz is a car-free, ski-in/ski-out resort at about 1,800 m above Morzine, built in distinctive wood-clad architecture. Its own sector has about 35 lifts and 54 runs, and it sits at the centre of the Portes du Soleil, which links 12 resorts across France and Switzerland (about 600 km of pistes and 209 lifts).
learning: The Avoriaz sector has 8 green and 27 blue runs (search summary). Reference: beginner areas are in the village; confirm beginner-lift access and lessons for 2026-27.
